instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. In an indoor boxing gym, the man with a braided mohawk and beard in a black t-shirt (R2) stands on the left in profile, facing right. He uses his tattooed right hand to hold and adjust the black boxing glove of the woman with braided hair in a black strapless top (R1) on the right. She looks forward with a gentle smile, holding her guard up. A blurred bystander in dark clothing is visible in the background near a punching bag. Bright overhead gym lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows.
